title: Privileged Access Management (PAM) for Cloud Admins
description: Ensure multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enforced for all privileged Azure AD roles (Global Admins, Security Admins, etc.).
remediation: Enable Conditional Access policies enforcing MFA for all administrative roles in Azure AD.

title: Tenant Isolation in Multi-Tenant Environments
description: Ensure logical segregation of tenant data using Azure AD B2B and B2C policies to prevent unauthorized cross-tenant access.
remediation: Configure Azure AD Cross-Tenant Access Settings to restrict inbound/outbound collaboration.

title: Azure AD Audit Logs
description: Enable Azure AD audit logs and diagnostic settings for monitoring privileged operations and security events.
remediation: Configure Azure AD diagnostic settings to stream logs to Log Analytics or SIEM.

title: Encryption of Data in Transit/At Rest
description: Ensure Azure AD data is encrypted using Microsoft-managed keys or customer-managed keys (CMK).
remediation: Enable Azure AD encryption and consider CMK for sensitive workloads.

title: Third-Party App Consent Policies
description: Restrict third-party application access to Azure AD data via OAuth permissions.
remediation: Configure Azure AD App Consent Policies to limit user consent for apps.

title: Incident Response for Identity Threats
description: Enable Azure AD Identity Protection and configure risk-based policies for automated incident response.
remediation: Configure risk-based Conditional Access policies for high-risk sign-ins.

title: Compliance with Data Residency Requirements
description: Ensure Azure AD data residency aligns with regulatory requirements.
remediation: Verify Azure AD tenant region and configure geo-restrictions if needed.

title: User Registration & Deregistration Automation
description: Ensure automated user lifecycle management (joiner-mover-leaver) via Azure AD Identity Governance.
remediation: Configure Azure AD Lifecycle Workflows or SCIM-based auto-provisioning.

title: Secure Authentication Secrets Management
description: Enforce phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2/Windows Hello) for all users.
remediation: Disable SMS/voice MFA and enforce FIDO2 or Authenticator app.

title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Azure AD
description: Ensure least-privilege access using Azure AD PIM (Privileged Identity Management).
remediation: Activate PIM and configure time-bound role assignments.

title: Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) for Azure AD
description: Use Azure Key Vault to manage encryption keys for sensitive data.
remediation: Configure Azure AD to use CMK via Key Vault.

title: Azure AD Sign-In & Audit Log Retention
description: Retain logs for ≥90 days to meet compliance requirements.
remediation: Configure diagnostic settings to export logs to Log Analytics.

title: Admin Activity Logging
description: Enable Azure AD Privileged Access Workloads for critical operations.
remediation: Enable PIM audit logs and alert on privileged role assignments.

title: Business Continuity for Azure AD
description: Ensure geo-redundant Azure AD deployments.
remediation: Enable Azure AD cross-region replication.

title: PII Protection in Azure AD
description: Enable Azure AD Identity Protection for sensitive data access.
remediation: Configure sensitivity labels and DLP policies for PII.

title: Restrict Guest User Access
description: Ensure guest users have the most restrictive access to directory objects.
remediation: Configure Azure AD guest access to 'restricted to limited properties'.

title: Restrict Entra Admin Center Access
description: Restrict non-admin user access to Microsoft Entra admin center.
remediation: Disable non-admin access to the Entra admin center by setting defaultUserRolePermissions.allowedToAccessAADAdminPortal = false.

title: Restrict LinkedIn Integration
description: Disable LinkedIn account connections with work/school identities unless explicitly required.
remediation: Enable LinkedIn restrictions to prevent account connections, unless a business justification exists.

title: Cross-Tenant Access Default Deny
description: Ensure inbound and outbound cross-tenant access defaults are set to Deny.
remediation: Block cross-tenant access by default and configure partner-specific allow rules.

title: Restrict Tenant Trust Settings
description: Disable automatic trust of MFA/compliant device claims from external tenants unless explicitly approved.
remediation: Require proof of external tenant security posture before enabling inbound trust claims.

title: Restrict Group Self-Service
description: Disable user self-service for creating and managing Microsoft 365 groups.
remediation: Restrict group creation to administrators or use approved workflows for provisioning.

title: Restrict App Registrations by Non-Admins
description: Prevent non-admin users from registering applications unless explicitly allowed.
remediation: Restrict application registrations to a designated administrator or developer group.
